title: Old Montreal at Twilight Private Tour
includes: Accredited, fun, and upbeat guides will make your experience unforgettable.
Explore the Old Montreal at your own pace with a passionate, local guide.
To make communication easier, you will receive name and number of your guide.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Explore the Old Montreal after dark on this private walking tour. Let your local guide take the hassle out of navigating the narrow streets. Gain a new appreciation for Montreal's history and culture. From the awe-inspiring Notre-Dame Basilica (outside only) to the once-wealthiest streets in Canada and Montreal's Old Port, discover this unique piece of Europe hidden behind the skyscrapers of downtown.
